text.p: NWE oil products were mixed on Monday, traders said.
Gas oil eased on lower futures, sloppy supply and low demand in a moribund market. Heating oil barges were talked at around flat/+50 cents fob AR for refinery material.
Naphtha was unchanged amid sluggish demand from petrochems and steady supplies of full range grades.
Gasoline rose with Rotterdam barges trading at $194 fob early in the afternoon but otherwise the market was quiet.

High sulphur fuel oil barges rose to trade once at $87.50 fob Rotterdam after one trading house was reported to be having problems with deliveries. Two earlier trades during the day were done at $87 a tonne fob ARA.
Cargoes were weaker, with a cracked high sulphur cargo reported traded at $82 cif. One percent was stronger with little avails after a 75,000-tonne cargo was said sold at $94.75 fob late on Friday.
